verses.1: As for time and seasons, brothers, there’s no need for you to write about them.
verses.2: For you surely knew that it would be a day when the Lord would come as a thief, in the night.
verses.3: When they say “peace and security”, then suddenly, a flood of people will rush towards them, just like food that enters the stomach. And they won’t be able to escape.
verses.4: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, so that the day may see you as thieves.
verses.5: For all of you, children of light, you are also children of the day. There is no darkness or darkness at all.
verses.6: Therefore, we should not delay like the others; instead, we should act quickly and make progress.
verses.7: For those who break through at night, they will be able to do so; and those who drink wine at night, they will be able to do so as well.
verses.8: We, being men of today, are born again, wearing the armor of faith and love, and carrying within us the hope of salvation.
verses.9: Because God did not keep us in anger, but for our salvation, through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.10: For the one who has died, may we be able to live together with him, either quickly or slowly.
verses.11: Therefore, please help each other and build one another’s houses, just as you would do it yourself.
verses.12: We ask you, brothers, to know those who cut down trees among you, and those who stand before you in the king’s court, and those who deceive you.
verses.13: And they should be praised for their efforts, out of love for their work. You should be satisfied with this.
verses.14: We ask you, brothers, to be patient with those who are slow to understand, to endure those who are difficult to please, and to be long-suffering toward everyone.
verses.15: See that no one gives anything bad in return for anything good. Instead, always seek out what is good for each other and for everyone else.
verses.18: Thank you in every way; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
verses.19: Don’t let the spirit go away.
verses.20: The prophecies are not to be obeyed from without.
verses.21: But always test everything, and make sure it’s good quality.
verses.22: Stay away from all kinds of evil people.
verses.23: May the Lord of peace sanctify you completely. May your spirit, soul, and body be preserved without any defilement during the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.24: I am a trustworthy person, and I will do what is right.
verses.26: You have taken all your brothers into a holy relationship.
verses.27: I swear to you that this letter will be read by all the brothers.
verses.28: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you.
